Fetch and convert OpenAlex data to Parquet

Source: R/pro_fetch.R
pro_fetch.Rd

Convenience wrapper that downloads records from OpenAlex via pro_request() and converts them directly to an Apache Parquet dataset via pro_request_parquet(). No intermediate JSONL files are written.

Usage

pro_fetch(
  query_url,
  pages = 10000,
  project_folder = NULL,
  overwrite = FALSE,
  api_key = pro_api_key(),
  delete_input = TRUE,
  workers = 1,
  download_workers = workers,
  verbose = FALSE,
  progress = TRUE,
  enrich = TRUE,
  count_only,
  error_log = NULL,
  resume = FALSE,
  via = c("url", "oqo"),
  inconsistency_on_resume = c("error", "warning", "ignore", "oldest", "newest"),
  compact_parquet = NULL
)

Arguments

query_url

The URL of the API query or a list of URLs returned from pro_query().

pages

The maximum number of pages (of 200 records) downloaded per query; for a list, the limit applies to each leaf query. 100000 pages are 20,000,000 records; for more, use the snapshot instead. If NULL, all pages will be downloaded.

project_folder

Directory where intermediate (json) and final (parquet) results are stored. If it does not exist, it is created. If NULL, a temporary directory is created.

overwrite

Logical. If TRUE, the json and parquet subdirectories are deleted from project_folder before the pipeline starts. If FALSE (the default) and any of those subdirectories already exist, the function stops with an error.

api_key

Character string API key or NULL. Defaults to pro_api_key(). If NULL or "", requests are sent without an API key (subject to OpenAlex's unauthenticated limits).

delete_input

Logical. If TRUE (the default), the json subfolder is deleted after successful conversion to Parquet.

workers

Number of parallel workers for the conversion to Parquet (CPU and memory bound), and by default also for the download. Default 1.

download_workers

Number of parallel workers for the download, used when query_url is a list. Defaults to workers. Downloads are limited by the API rather than the machine, so a few (e.g. 2–4) are usually enough, while the conversion can use more.

verbose

Logical indicating whether to show verbose messages.

progress

Logical indicating whether to show a progress bar. Default TRUE.

enrich

Logical. When TRUE (the default) and the inferred schema contains abstract_inverted_index / authorships / publication_year, add abstract and citation computed columns.

count_only

Do not use it here. The function will abort if set to TRUE and give a warning if FALSE.

error_log

location of error log of API calls. (default: NULL (none)).

resume

Logical. When TRUE, keep existing json and parquet subfolders and complete an interrupted run: only leaf queries that did not finish are downloaded again, and only missing Parquet files are converted. A finished run is returned unchanged. overwrite is ignored. Default FALSE.

via

How each query is sent. "url" (default): as a GET request with the query in the URL, as built by pro_query(). "oqo": translated once (free) into an OpenAlex Query Object and sent via POST, with the same results. It has no URL length limit, accepts more than 100 values per filter (so pro_query(..., chunk_limit = 200) fetches a DOI or ID list in about one page per chunk), checks the query before any credits are spent, and records the exact query in _query.json. Single records (works/W123) are always fetched via GET.

inconsistency_on_resume

What to do when a query that was resumed in the middle turns out inconsistent, because OpenAlex's data changed between the sessions: records that appear twice (found exactly, by work ID) or missing records (only as a net difference to OpenAlex's current count – a record lost and another added cancel out). "error" (default) stops; nothing is lost, and a rerun with resume = TRUE and another value applies that choice without downloading again. "warning" keeps both copies and warns, "ignore" keeps both silently, "oldest" / "newest" keep the first / last downloaded copy (removing the other from its page file) and warn about missing records.

compact_parquet

NULL (default) keeps one Parquet file per API page. A number, e.g. 250000, combines each query's page files into files of up to that many records once every file has converted – much faster to read. See pro_compact_parquet().

Value

Invisibly, the normalised path of the parquet subfolder inside project_folder.

Details

The function

  • downloads records from OpenAlex via pro_request() into a "json" subfolder of project_folder, and

  • converts the JSON files to an Apache Parquet dataset via pro_request_parquet() into a "parquet" subfolder.

This function assumes count_only == FALSE

See also

pro_request() for the download step, pro_request_parquet() for the conversion step, pro_compact_parquet() to compact an existing dataset.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Combine each query's page files into files of up to 250,000 records,
# which are much faster to read
pro_fetch(
  pro_query(search = "coral reef", from_publication_date = "2020-01-01"),
  project_folder = "coral_reef",
  compact_parquet = 250000
)
} # }
